articles.title: NASA Develops Blockchain Technology to Enhance Air Travel Safety and Security
articles.summary: Through a drone flight test at NASA’s Ames Research Center, researchers tested a blockchain-based system for protecting flight data. The system aims to keep air traffic management safe from disruption and protect data transferred between aircraft and ground stations from being intercepted or manipulated.
